notes.title: Blacksea Odyssey Version 1.2 Released!
notes.content:
[b]Ahoy, space-huntsman![/b] Thanks for everyone's feedback and bug reports - they have been a HUGE help!  We fixed a ton of issues that players were having and also added in some new features. 

[h1]Blacksea Odyssey v1.2[/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Water Spear Rune 1,2,3, and 4 
[*]Added Legendary Spear Rune Ellery Spear (Named after one of our biggest fans)
[*]Added Taco Bomb
[*]Added Tacopocalypse (Named after our friends game Tacopocalypse)
[*]Added a remove screenshake option
[*]Added a custom controller option (for people that want to use their own controller input)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the game to crash while fighting the leviathan.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the game to crash post round 5.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the game to lag post round 4.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing audio to leak from round to round.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing puffers to disspear.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing an issue with saving/loading.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased rades damage passive from 10% to 20%.
[*]Increased Coupe De Graces critical damage from 1000% to 1500%.
[*]Increased one eighty shot spear damage by 5, 10, 15, and 20.
[*]Enemies have a higher quality rune drop chance in later stages of the game.
[*]Chests have a higher quality rune drop chance in later stages of the game.
[*]Chests have a higher chance to drop runes.
[*]Chests drop more credits.
[*]Shop has a higher chance to hold runes.
[*]Shop has a higher chance to hold higher quality runes.
[*]Shop has a GREATLY higher chance to drop epics/legendaries late game.
[/list]

If you have any bug send an email to TeamBlackseaOdyssey@gmail.com and also send us this file when the bug occurs.

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\BlackseaOdyssey\BlackseaOdyssey_Data\output_log.txt

Thanks again and enjoy! :D

- Team Blacksea Odyssey

[b]Ahoy, space-huntsman![/b] Sorry for the delay on posting the patch notes! We added 6 new unlockable spears AND the unlockable Elite Mode - in which all of the enemies spawn as elites. o.0 Unlock the new spears - if you can ;) We're looking forward to hearing which is your favorite!

[h1]Blacksea Odyssey v0.9.1[/h1]

[b]Features Added[/b]
[list][*]Added new consumable items: Nitrus Injector 1, 2, 3, and 4[/*][*]Added new elite enemy type. [b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list][*]Fixed items overlapping in the belt[/*][*]Fixed elite bosses not spawning as elites[/*][*]Fixed game over and win music playing at full volume when music volume was turned off[/*][*]Fixed The Seven Blights not dropping items[/*][*]Fixed Ice Trail damage text to appear red instead of blue[/*][*]Fixed Long Shot runes displaying improper damage per second[/*][*]Fixed Poison Shot 2 displaying improper damage[/*][/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Reduced Sandchawer's health by 15%[/*][*]Reduced Sandchawer's rotational speed by 20%[/*][*]Reduced Sandchawer's max speed by 10%[/*][*]Made Sandchawers less likely to stack next to each other[/*][*]Increased Athrel the Fallen's movement speed by 40%[/*][*]Increased Wyv The Elder's health by 30%[/*][*]Wyv the Elder now chases the player when attacking[/*][*]Increased Wyv the Elder's projectile speed by 10%[/*][*]Cthulhu's arms now swing slower when you rip them apart[/*][*]Increased the cooldown between Cthulhu's arm swing attacks by 3 seconds[/*][*]Increased Cthulhu's health by 10%[/*][*]Nerfed Mercury's base damage by 1 and its attack speed by 10%[/*][*]Increased Nethergoblin's far ram speed by 30% and increased far ram travel distance by 30%[/*][*]Increased Rackjaw's head's health by 75%[/*][/list]

notes.title: New Squid-like, Poison Spitting Jungle Enemies!
notes.content:
[b]Ahoy Space-Huntsmen![/b] We hope everyone had a great holiday season! We're glad to be back to work after a long [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/820296110/blacksea-odyssey]Kickstarter campaign[/url]. Thanks to you, we raised $12,300 which will help us finish the game!

We'd also like to thank everyone that has contributed feedback. We've been fortunate that tons of people reached out via Twitter, Facebook, email, and the contact form to share their thoughts and ideas about [url=http://blackseaodyssey.com]Blacksea Odyssey[/url]. We've been hard at work tweaking the game according to this feedback, but we're going to spend this blog post talking about a jungle enemy genome that we have yet to touch on - the Shelled Squid genome. :)

[h1]The Shelled Squid Genome[/h1]

Now we'd like to introduce to you three new enemies of the Shelled Squid genome which can be found in the Tropical biome! Shelled Squids draw inspiration from squids and hermit crabs! The Shelled Squid genome consists of the Shelled Squidlet, the Shelled Hulksquid, and the Shelled Megasquid.

[h1]The Shelled Squidlet[/h1]

[url=http://imgur.com/Uan0Fsk][img]http://i.imgur.com/Uan0Fsk.gif[/img][/url]
Shelled Squidlets navigate around their prey by firing poison projectiles which propel them forward, shell first. This enables them to make abrupt strides across the screen, allow them to catch the player off-guard. Depending on the player's position, Shelled Squidlets attack by either firing a poison projectile at the player, or trying to ram the player with it's thorned shell. They're smaller and quicker than other Shelled Squids, making them more dangerous in packs.

[h1]The Shelled Hulksquid[/h1]

[url=http://imgur.com/gJlmc73][img]http://i.imgur.com/gJlmc73.gif[/img][/url]
Shelled Hulksquids share many similarities with their smaller, Shelled Squidlet kin. The major difference revolves around size. Shelled Hulksquids have larger bodies, larger shells, and fire larger poison projectiles. Their large strides across the screen can be more invasive to the player, especially when already in combat with other enemies. Thankfully, it's less common for Shelled Hulksquids to travel in packs.

[h1]The Shelled Megasquid[/h1]

This enables them to make abrupt strides across the screen, allow them to catch the player off-guard. They're smaller and quicker than other Shelled Squids, making them more dangerous in packs.

Shelled Hulksquids have larger bodies, larger shells, and fire larger poison projectiles. Thankfully, it's less common for Shelled Hulksquids to travel in packs.
